call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance raised to 23% from 22-23%, after ESOP, Arinna and pre-revenue site costs.
Gross margin rose 140 bps sequentially to 67.7% despite higher input and freight costs.
Top 5 products were 39% and top 10 were 55% of Q1 revenue, in line with the last four quarters.
New Jersey site bought for USD 2.9 million via bankruptcy; May 2026 FDA inspection now classified VAI.
New Jersey commercialization expected in CY2027 after quality management systems are implemented.
CFO Nitin Jajodia moves to Chief Commercial Officer; Rohit joins as CFO designate.
On US tariffs, management did not quantify exposure; an analyst noted 97% of exports go to the US.
Asked on the standalone-versus-consolidated inventory and transfer-pricing gap, management offered to take it offline.
Management declined to give the number of products under FDA review, saying it will disclose once a year.
EBITDA margin guidance is maintained in the 22% to 23% range despite near-term gross margin pressures.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated from the Q4FY26 earnings call

call_points.text: Pithampur facility is on track, with site qualification complete and awaiting an inspection date from the US FDA.
Projected capex for the next couple of years is close to ₹300 crores across various sites.
Revenue growth has been broad-based across established products and new launches, with top 5 products accounting for 39% of revenue.
Gross margins experienced a slight decline due to internal manufacturing constraints and increased reliance on outsourced manufacturing.
R&D expense for Q4 FY26 was 11.6% of operating revenues, and R&D productivity stands at 5.9x.
Operating EBITDA margin is expected to sustain in the 22-23% range even if gross margins face near-term pressure from outsourced manufacturing.
Pithampur site production is expected to ramp up in Q1 CY27, which will be gross margin accretive.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Metacel Patent Infringement Action - Metacel Pharmaceuticals LLC initiated a Complaint against Rubicon Research [Private] Limited on 29 October 2021. Rubicon won its Summary Judgment Motion, with a Final Judgment entered on 31 August 2023, the Court finding that “Rubicon’s ANDA Product that is the subject of ANDA No. 214445 (the “Rubicon ANDA”) does not infringe any claim of the ’502 patent.” Rubicon successfully defended its Judgment before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit and returned the action to U.S. District Court (see e.g. Dkt. Nos. 164 and 170.) The Rubicon Antitrust Counterclaim - Defendant, Rubicon Research [Private] Limited’s First Amended Answer, Affirmative Defenses and Counterclaim was filed on 8 August 2023, thereby initiating suit against Counterclaim Defendant, Metacel. The Counterclaim action would be stayed, by virtue of Metacel’s Appeal of the Trial Court’s Final Judgment of Non-Infringement, to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. Following entry of the Fed. Cir. Opinion affirming the Trial Court’s Decision on 23 April 2025, Rubicon sought and received an Order lifting the case stay (Dkt. No. 168) and has continued to pursue its antitrust counterclaim against Metacel through 31 December 2025.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Metacel Pharmaceuticals LLC (Counterclaim filed by Rubicon Research Limited
tax_litigation.status: Rubicon Counterclaim: Ongoing. The matter is currently in the discovery phase.

timeline.summary: Rubicon Research received an Income Tax Assessment Order for AY 2023-24 with a demand of ₹17.25 Cr.
2026-04-24: USFDA inspection at Rubicon Research's R&D facility in Canada ends without Form-483 issuance
Rubicon Research completed the 85% stake acquisition of Arinna Lifesciences Limited on April 30, 2026.
Rubicon Research released its monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹335.15 Cr of IPO proceeds utilized.
Rubicon Research Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, for Q4FY26 and FY26 results with CEO Parag Sancheti, CFO Nitin Jajodia, and SVP Sagar Oak.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹513.91 Cr, net profit ₹76.78 Cr.
2026-05-29: Rubicon Research reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹513.91 Cr (+43.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹76.78 Cr (+111.8% YoY), and recommended a dividend of ₹1.50 per share.
Rubicon Research approved the ESOP 2026 scheme for 24,84,415 equity shares, subject to shareholder approval.
Rubicon Research extended its unutilised IPO proceeds utilisation timeline by one year to March 31, 2027.
Rubicon Research reported Q4 FY26 earnings, reiterating its 22-23% EBITDA margin guidance and updating on the Pithampur facility ramp-up.
On 14 August 2026 Rubicon Research's Q1FY27 call reported revenue up 52% YoY to ₹534 Cr and raised FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 23%.
